metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 inspector and renderer in [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py). It supports header and record parsing, point formats 0–10, CRS records, Extra Bytes, waveform records, and LAS-specific validation errors.

Verified it compiles and round-trips the sample request, all point formats, and an internal waveform EVLR. Run it from `/workspace` with `python output/main.py --input <path> --output <path>`.
